༄༅/ /kun rig gi dbang bskur rnam grol sgo chen 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// kun rig gi dbang bskur rnam grol sgo chen 'byed pa'i lde mig ces bya ba bzhugs so//

na mo sarba bi da ye/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i sgo nas slob ma rjes su bzung ba'i rim pa la/ bdag bskyed/ bum bskyed/ mdun bskyed/ bdag 'jug bcas grub nas dbang bskur ba la/ thog mar khrus dang maṇḍal bkye bsdu zin nas/ nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang rin po che thob par bya/ de'i ched du bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor du smin par byed pa'i dbang bskur zab mo zhu snyam pa'i thugs bskyed kyi sgo nas gsan par 'tshal/ de yang bdag cag gi ston pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thabs mkhas la thugs rje chen po'i phrin las dang ldan pa des gdul bya so so'i blo dang khams dang bag la nyal rnams so sor mkhyen nas chos kyi sgo dpag tu med pa zhig gsungs pa rnams ni/ rgyu phar phyin theg pa dang*/ 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa gnyis su 'dus shing*/ rdo rje theg pa de la yang*/ gtso che ba'i dbang du byas na/ ye shes rdo rje kun las btus pa'i rgyud las/ dman pa rnams ni bya ba'i rgyud// bya min rnal 'byor de ltag la// sems can mchog la rnal 'byor mchog /ces gsungs pa bzhin/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud dang*/ rgyud sde chen po bzhir bzhugs pa las 'di rnal 'byor gyi rgyud yin/ de la rtsa ba dang bshad pa dang cha mthun dang*/ 'phros pa'i rgyud bzhi las 'phros pa'i rgyud yin/ lha 'di'i ngo bo ni spyan ras gzigs longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku 'og min 'thug po bkod du bzhugs pa'i rnam snang gang chen mtsho de nyid yin la/ de'ang rgyud ji ltar byung ba'i tshul ni/ sngon 'das pa'i sangs rgyas bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhis kyang gsungs la/ bstan pa 'di la bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa sum cu rtsa gsum lha gnas dga' ba'i tshal gyi gzhal med khang chen por 'khor byang chub sems dpa' bye ba phrag mang po dang*/

'jig rten pa brgya byin la sogs pa lha mang po dang thabs gcig tu padma'i gdan la bzhugs nas/ ngan song gi rgyud thams cad yongs su sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par bzhugs pas mdzod spu nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'phros shing*/ sems can thams cad nyon mongs pa'i 'ching ba las grol zhing*/ bde ba so sor thob ste dga' ba'i tshal thams cad snang bar byas/ de'i tshe brgya byin ngo mtshar du gyur nas lha'i bu nor bu dri ma med pa'i 'od tshe 'phos pa ngan song du skyes pa thar pa'i ched du gsol ba btab pa'i ngor brtag pa dang po bcom ldan 'das nyid kyis gsungs shing*/ phyag na rdo rje byin gyis brlabs nas brtag pa gnyis pa gsungs/ de nas slar yang phyag rdor nyid khro bo me ltar 'bar ba'i skur bzhengs nas phyag rdor gtso bor gyur ba'i dkyil 'khor bdun sogs gsungs pas brgya byin la sogs pa rnams rjes su yi rangs te mchod pa dang*/ mtshan brgya rtsa brgyad kyi sgo nas bstod cing lha'i bu de ngan song nas thar te byang chub chen po'i go 'phang la bkod par mdzad do// de lta bu'i rgyud 'di lha yul du bzhugs pa/ sangs rgyas mya ngan las 'das nas lo nyer brgyad 'das pa na/ rgya gar shar lho'i phyogs grong khyer pa ti kīrti bya bar rgyal po rab gsal zla ba'am dza zhes grags pa'i khang steng du glegs bam gyi char babs pa dang mnyam du byon cing*/ gsang ba'i bdag pos rdo rje dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor sprul nas dbang bskur/ rgyud kyi bka' gtad rjes su gnang bar mdzad/ rgyal po sgra gcan zin bzang po/ ye shes rdo rje/ pradzña siddhi/ rab 'byor skyong dang bzhi la gnang*/ de bzhi ka'i drung nas slob dpon kun dga' snying po zhes/ 'jam dpal rtsa rgyud las/ yi ge a ming sdom brtson pa// ston pa'i bstan pa gsal byed 'byung*// zhes lung du bstan pa'i slob dpon de nyid kyis gsan pa ste/

de yang rnal 'byor rgyud kyi tshig la mkhas pa shākya bshes gnyen/ don la mkhas pa sangs rgyas gsang ba/ tshig don gnyis ka la mkhas pa kun dga' snying po ste yo ga la mkhas pa mi gsum sogs kyis gtan la phab pa rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du nyi zla ltar grags shing*/ gangs can bod kyi yul 'dir bstan pa snga dar chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi dus su ngan song sbyong pa'i rgyud dang slob dpon sangs rgyas gsang ba'i 'grel pa sogs bsgyur/ phyi dar gyi dus lo chen rin chen bzang po'i sku tshe'i stod la paṇa chen dharmā pa lar zhus nas yo ga stod lugs su grags pa dang*/ sku tshe'i smad la kun snying gi lugs su mdzad pas yo ga smad lugs su grags pa byung zhing rnal 'byor rgyud kyi bstan pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzad nas sku lus ma bzhag par mkha' spyod du byon/ de nas snye mdo ba kun dga' don grub kyi drung nas thams cad mkhyen pa rang byung rdo rjes gsan zhing rim par brgyud nas rje don ldan zhabs dang*/ chos grags rgya mtsho sogs kyis rgyas bsdus mang du mdzad pa las/ 'di ni paṇḍi ta kun dga' snying pos rnal 'byor rgyud du bkral ba'i sgrub thabs jo bo smṛ ti dzñā nas rang 'gyur du mdzad pa'i bka' srol ji lta ba bzhin du/ kun mkhyen mi bskyod rdo rjes mdzad pa'i sgrub dkyil rnam rol sgo chen gyi steng nas dbang bskur ba yin te/ de'ang rgyud las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lha'i dbang po nyon cig /sems can dmyal ba la sogs pa'i dbang du gyur pa'i sems can sdig pa byed pa/ sdig pa chen po byed pa de dag ci nas kyang*/ sems can dmyal ba'i sdug bsngal las/ thabs sla bas grol bar 'gyur pa nyon cig /de bzhin dkyil 'khor bris nas ni// de ltar yang ni bum pa la// brgya rtsa brgyad du bzlas nas ni// dbang bskur bar ni rab tu brtags// de nas sdig pa kun sbyangs te// dmyal ba la sogs sdug bsngal las// de ni myur du rnam par thar// sdig las bdag nyid rnam grol te// dag par 'gyur ba'i lha rnams kyis// rigs su skye bar gyur nas kyang*// de ni rtag tu sangs rgyas dang*// chos 'gro ba ni thob par 'gyur// phyir mi ldog pa'i sa la gnas// rim gyis byang chub thob par 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// de lta bu'i phan yon dang byin rlabs mchog dang ldan pa'i dbang bskur zhu bar byed pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi bar 'os pa'i bdag mdun bum pa bsgrub pa/

bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len pa dang bcas pa grub nas/ da khyed rang slob ma rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa'i maṇḍal phul/ zhes maṇḍal phul/ de ltar maṇḍal phul ba sngon du song nas dkyil 'khor du 'jug cing dbang zhu ba'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod// dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon chen po dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug par 'tshal// lan gsum/ da khyed rang rnams kyi mdun gyi nam mkhar bla ma dang gnyis su med pa'i kun rig rtsa ba'i lha sum cu so bdun dang mgron thabs kyi lha dang bcas pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba sprin gyi phung po ltar bzhugs pa'i drung du khyed rang rnams kyi thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad bshags/ rgyal ba sras dang bcas pas bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs bsags shing 'gro ba'i don mdzad pa la rjes su yi rang*/ dus 'di nas bzung dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro zhing byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la bkod pa'i ched du/ dus rtag tu pha rol tu phyin pa drug la spyod par bgyi'o snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dbang med bdag gis mi dge bgyis pa dang*// rjes su yi rang yang na bgyid stsal gang*// de dag thams cad byang chub mchog gi ni// spyan sngar da lta ma lus so sor bshags// bde gshegs sras kyi tshogs gnyis zab pa dang*// rgya chen 'gro ba ma lus pa yi don// sgrub par byed dang de las gzhan la yang*// rtag tu bdag ni rjes su yi rang ngo*// thugs rjes khyab pa'i thugs dang ldan gyur cig

/blo gros sdig bral gti mug tshogs kun bcom// ma lus rigs kyi padma'i nang bzhugs pa'i// bde bar gshegs pa rnams la skyabs su mchi// blo mchog rnams kyi kun dga' ra ba ste// dman pas 'jigs pa rnams kyi rgyal byed tshal// srid pa'i 'byor ba zil gyis gnon pa'i mchog /gsung mchog chos la bdag ni skyabs su mchi// 'dod chags la sogs sbrul gyi dug bcom zhing*// blo gros rnam dag thugs rje ldan pa yi// brtul zhugs dbang po'i tshogs la skyabs mchi zhing*// srid dang bral ba rnams la'ang bdag phyag 'tshal// rgyu yi rjes la bdag po'i yul bdag nyid// 'bras bu'i stobs kyis dgra las rgyal gyur pa'i// snying rje'i rtsa ba zug cing yang dag rtogs// mnyam med byang chub sems ni bskyed par bgyid// sems can rnams ni yongs su smin pa'am// yang na yongs su bskyang bar bya phyir ram// rang gi sems ni dag par bya ba'i phyir// 'di dag thams cad rtswa sog bzhin du btang*// de bzhin tshul khrims bzod pa brtson 'grus dang*// bsam gtan shes rab bla na med pa ni// bdag dang gzhan rnams dag par bya ba'i phyir// skad cig re re zhing yang bsgom par bgyi// bde bar gshegs pa sngags la mkhas pa yi// chos rgyal rtag tu lhun gyis grub pa ni// 'gro ba 'di yis thob par bya ba'i phyir// khyad 'phags gnas la bdag ni gnas par bgyi// gsum/ de ltar mdo sngags thun mong gi skyabs 'gro sems bskyed song nas/ thun mong ma yin pa sngags kyi dam tshig dang sdom pa khas len pa ni/ rigs lnga spyi'i dam tshig byang chub tu sems bskyed nas de'i bslab bya tshul khrims kyi bslab pa dang*/ dge ba'i chos sdud pa dang*/ sems can gyi don byed pa dang*/ rnam snang gi dam tshig tu rgyu dkon mchog gsum 'dzin pa sogs rigs lnga so so'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

mgon po sangs rgyas rnams dang ni// sras bcas bdag la dgongs su gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bya ba yis// byang chub snying po mchis kyi bar// ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams// byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por bzung bar bgyi// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i// sdom pa deng nas bzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu'i phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re bzhin du dus drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba'i theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos ni gzung bar bgyi// las gyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// byang chub sems ni bla med pa// dam pa bdag gis bskyed bgyis nas// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag gis sdom pa ma lus gzung*// ma brgal ba rnams bsgral bar bgyi// ma grol ba rnams dgrol bar bgyi// dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung bgyi// sems can mya ngan 'das la 'god// lan gsum/ khyod rang gi snying gar kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du don dam pa byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pa zhig bsgom la thams cad rdo rje'i rnal 'byor du sems bskyed pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/

oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi/ lan gsum/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar rdo rje 'dis reg pas sems bskyed pa de mi nyams shing brtan par gyur snyam pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar rdo rjes reg / su ra te sa ma ya st+waṃ hoḥ siddhi badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi dpral bar oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po rtsibs bcu gnyis pa'i lte bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par padma dmar po 'dab ma bcu drug pa'i ze'u 'brur āḥdamar po/ snying gar rdo rje sngon po rtse lnga pa'i lte bar hūm̐ sngon pos mtshan pa sku gsung thugs rdo rje gsum du byin gyis brlab pa'i mos pa mdzod/ rigs gsum spyi'i phyag rgya gnas gsum du gtugs la/ oṃ bṛ ta bṛ ta sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ traṭa traṭa sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ tshindha tshindha sarba ā ba ra ṇā ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ de nas khyed rang rnams kyi gnas nyer gnyis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ snying ga mgrin pa dpral ba dang*// smin mtshams mdzod spu phrag pa gnyis// mgo bo gtsug phud dpung pa gnyis// sna dang rked pa pus mo bol// long bu gnyis dang mig gnyis dang*// gsang ba'i gnas rnams su zla ba rdo rje re res byin gyis brlab par sgoms shig /oṃ sarba bid badzra a dhiṣṭhā na dzñā na sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes rdo rje'i phyag rgya bstan/ sngags nyer gnyis sam gsum/ de nas dge ba'i rtsa ba byang chub tu bsngo ba 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bdag gi dge ba'i rtsa ba 'di yang sems can thams cad dang thun mong du byas te rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang myur du thob par gyur cig / zhes brjod/ zab mo'i chos bshad pa ni rnam snang mngon byang nas gsungs pa 'di la gsan pas khyab par 'dug /'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dum wā ra'i me tog bzhin// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// gsang sngags spyod pa'i tshul 'byung ba// de bas kyang ni dkon pa ste// gang gis sems can mnyam med don// bla med byed par nus pa yin// bskal pa bye ba du ma ru// sngon du sdig pa byas pa gang*// dkyil 'khor 'di 'dra mthong ma thag

/de dag zad par 'gyur yin na// grags pa mtha' yas sngags spyod pa'i// tshul la gnas na smos ci dgos// skyob pa'i gsang sngags bzlas na ni// go 'phang bla na med par 'gyur// gang dag spyod pa mchog 'di la// blo gros shin tu mi g.yo na// sdug bsngal thams cad 'byung ba yi// ngan 'gro de yis gcod par 'gyur// bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis// rnyed pa mnyam med de ring rnyed// gang phyir rgyal ba sras bcas pa'i// bdag nyid chen po kun gyi ni// bstan pa 'di la khyed rnams kun// yongs su bzung ste skye bzhin par// de phyir khyed rnams theg chen du// da lta rab tu skye bar 'gyur// theg pa chen po cher 'byung ba'i// lam mchog 'di ni dpal dang ldan// khyed rnams der ni dong bas na// rang byung skal ba chen po pa// 'jig rten thams cad mkhyen pa yi// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du 'gyur// de nas khro bo 'jig rten gsum rgyal gyi phyag rgya khyed rang rnams kyi gnas gsum du gtug cing khro bo'i sngags brjod pas/ khyed rang rnams kyi dbang zhu ba la bar du gcod pa dang*/ lus ngag yid gsum la gnod pa thams cad khro bo khams gsum rnam rgyal gyis bsrungs nas bar chad gang gis kyang mi tshugs par sgoms shig /oṃ badzra sa twā kro dha a na lārka ma hā badzra kro dha dra ba dra ba/ bi dra ba bi dra ba/ sarba a pā ya nā sha ya nā sha ya/ ha ra ha ra prā ṇā na hūm̐ phaṭa/ a dhi tiṣṭha swa maṃ/

lan gsum/ sngon chad dkyil 'khor chen po 'di ma mthong ba'i brdar ras yug dmar po kha tshar ma nyams pa zhig gis gdong g.yogs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra yakṣa hūm̐/ ā khaṃ bī ra hūm̐/ zhes mig dar gtad/ dkyil 'khor mjal ba la phyag rten du yang zhing khams ma nyams pa'i me tog gi phreng ba zhig gtad pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra a dhi tiṣṭha hūm̐/ zhes me tog gtad/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis rdo rje sems dpa'i skur gyur pa la nyer spyod lngas mchod par mos shig /oṃ badzra puṣpe dhū pe ā lo ke gandhe nai wi dya āḥhūm̐/ zhes pas mchod/ slob dpon gyi phyag gi rdo rje la 'jus te dkyil 'khor gyi nang du zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes dkyil 'khor du gzhug / de nas byin dbab pa ni khyed rang rdo rje sems dpar gsal ba'i snying gar rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par padma dmar po hrīḥs mtshan pa/ dpral bar rin chen ser po trām̐ gis mtshan pa/ spyi bor sna tshogs rdo rje ljang gu āḥs mtshan pa dang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i a yig las a yig dpag tu med pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes yi ge hūm̐ gi rnam pas lus la zhugs par gyur/ oṃ badzra pra we sha ya hūm̐/ mang nyung ci rigs drag tu brjod cing rol mo bya/ ye shes pa de brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag la/ a sa me/ tri sa me/ ma hā sa ma ya hūm̐/ da me tog de khyed rang gi tshe rabs nas las 'phro yod pa'i lha la dbab par shog bsam pa gyis la 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sangs rgyas dngos grub thob bya'i phyir// bdag la thugs brtser dgongs nas ni// 'gro la phan pa'i gtso chen gyis// sman par dgongs te bzhes su gsol// oṃ pra tītstsha sa ma ya st+waṃ/ zhes dkyil 'khor du me tog dor/ me tog gang la phog pa'i lha de tshe rabs kyi lha yin pas de'i byin rlabs me tog dang dbyer med par spyi bor thim par sgoms shig

/me tog rin chen gang du ni// babs par gyur pa'i rigs kyi lha// gtso bor rigs de bsgrubs na ni// dngos grub myur ster the tshom med// oṃ pra ti gṛ hṇa hūm̐/ zhes me tog mgor bcings/ de nas ma rig pa'i sgrib g.yogs dang lhan cig mig dar bsal ba'i mos pa mdzod/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyed kyi/ mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra hā sye urgha ṭa ya hūm̐/ zhes mig dar bsal/ oṃ badzra pā shya hoḥ de nas lha ngo bstan pa ni/ ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor 'di nyid 'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi zhing khams de yang bsrung ba'i 'khor lo 'jig rten pa'i 'khor yug dang bcas pa'i dbus su gzhal yas khang phyi nang gnyis ka rgyan dang bkod pa phun sum tshogs pa'i dbus su rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag rnam par snang mdzad/ phyogs bzhir sbyong ba'i rgyal po la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa bzhi/ mtshams bzhir sangs rgyas spyan ma la sogs pa'i gshegs ma bzhi/ chos kyi 'khor lo'i rtsibs rnams su rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa'i sems dpa' chen po bcu drug /grwa phyi nang bzhir sgeg sogs lha mo brgyad/ nang gi sgo bzhir rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs pa'i sgo ba bzhi/ dkyil 'khor phyi ma'i lha snam dang po la byams pa la sogs pa'i bskal bzang gi sems dpa' bcu drug /lha snam gnyis pa la ngan song sbyong ba la sogs pa'i dpe bral gyi sems dpa' bcu drug /lha snam gsum pa la dga' bo la sogs pa'i nyan thos bcu drug /lha snam bzhi pa la gdung ba sel ba sogs rang rgyal bcu gnyis/ sgo bzhir 'jig rten gsum snang sogs khro bo chen po brgyad/ khor yug la 'jig rten skyong ba rnams sogs mdor na bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa'i dkyil 'khor rten dang brten par bcas pa mngon sum du mthong ba'i mos pa mdzod/

ces ngo sprad/ lha de dag thams cad kyi dam tshig khyed rang rnams kyi rgyud la zhugs pa'i mos pa mdzod cig /oṃ badzra sa ma ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod/ dam tshig de brtan par byas pa'i mos pa mdzod/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ badzra sa ma ya hṛ da ya me pra we sha ya dṛ ḍha tiṣṭha hūm̐/ zhes dang*/ de nas dam tshig gi bdud rtsi sbyin pa ni/ dung chos kyi chu blud la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrung na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// ci ste dam tshig 'das na ni// de ma thag tu bkas nas gshegs// rdo rje 'dzin rgyal khros nas ni// bdun brgyud rigs ni brlag par mdzad// de bas rtag tu bu khyod kyis// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i dam tshig dang*// sdom pa dang ni bla ma'i bka'// shin tu mos pas bsrung bar bya// khyod kyis srog chags bsad mi bya// ma byin par yang blang mi bya// brdzun dang 'dod log spyod pa rnams// dngos grub 'dod pas bya ba min// chang ni btung bar mi bya zhing*// sha la sogs pa bza' mi bya// sems can gnod pa'i sbyor ba ni// nam yang bya ba ma yin no// dkon mchog gsum ni yongs mi spong*// dus kun tu ni byang chub sems// snying po sngags dang phyag rgya dang*// lha dang bla ma de bzhin no// sdig la sogs pa gang yin dang*// bla ma'i bka' las 'da' mi bya// lha la phul ba'i rnying pa dang*// de yi grib ma'ang 'gong mi bya// phyag rgya'i gzugs la'ang de bzhin no// sngags dang lha la smad mi bya// gdon gyi las sogs bya ba min// mu stegs can la smad mi bya// mdor na the tshom yid gnyis som nyi mi bya ste// bdag gi de nyid dang ni sngags sogs de bzhin no// de rnams kyi sta gon 'jug pa dang bcas pa'i chos bcu bdun song ba yin/ da dbang gi dngos gzhi zhu ba'i phyir maṇḍal phul/

maṇḍal phul la/ rgyud las/ sarba bid kyis ji ltar dbang bskur te// bum pa la sogs ji snyed mang thogs pas// bcu po rnams kyi dbang ni ci dgar bskur// de nas lag tu rdo rje dril bu sbyin// zhes gsungs pa ltar/ dang po sngags dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod cig /slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba byung zhal nas thon/ khyed rang gi zhal nas zhugs snying gar thim pa'i mos pa mdzod/ spyi bor rdo rje bzung la/ na mo bha ga wa te/ sarba durga te pa ri shwa dha ni rwa dza ya/ ta tha ga tā yārha te/ samyaksaṃ buddhā ya/ tadya thā/ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ne sarba pā paṃ bi sho dha ni shuddhe bi shuddhe sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na swā hā/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ya sarba a pā ya hūm̐/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ya sarba a pā ya trām̐/ oṃ sho dha ne sho dha ya sarba a pā ya hrīḥ oṃ sho dha ni sho dha ya sarba a pā ya āḥ o sho dha ne hūm̐/ oṃ sho dha ni trām̐/ oṃ sho dha ni hrīḥ oṃ sho dha ni āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas dbang bcu bskur ba la/ de bzhin gshegs pa bzhis dbang bskur ba'i dgongs pa mdzad/ sems dpa' rnams kyis shis pa brjod/ lha mo rnams kyis glu blangs/ khro bo brgyad kyis bgegs bskrad/ rdo rje ma bzhis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang bas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma thams cad dag /lha thams cad kyi spangs rtogs kyi yon tan thams cad rgyud la skyes pa'i mos pa mdzod/ bum pa thogs la/ rin chen mdzes pa'i bkra shis bum pa 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// las dang nyon mongs sgrib pa dag gyur te// byang chub sems kyi rlan gyis brlan par shog / rnam rgyal bum pa mgo bo'i gnas lngar bzhag la/ oṃ buddha kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ oṃ badzra kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ oṃ ratna kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/

oṃ padma kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa hrīḥ oṃ karma kā la sha a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ ཿ brjod cing bum chu 'thung du'ang gzhug / de ltar mi bskyod pa chu yi dbang bskur bas las dang nyon mongs pa'i sgrib pa dag ste byang chub sems kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ dbu rgyan thogs la/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i dbu rgyan cod pan 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas myur du thob par shog /oṃ buddha a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ badzra hūm̐/ ratna trām̐/ padma hrīḥ karma āḥ sogs brjod cing dbu rgyan bskon/ de ltar dbu rgyan gyi dbang bskur bas rigs lnga'i sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub thams cad thob pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rin po che'i phreng bas dbang bskur ba ni/ me tog phreng ba thogs la/ rin chen mdzes pa'i me tog phreng ba 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyed la dbang bskur bas// bsam pa myang 'das sbyor ba khams gsum gnas// mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs par shog /oṃ ratna mā la a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ zhes bskur/ de ltar rin po che'i phreng bas dbang bskur bas bsam pa mya ngan las 'das kyang sbyor ba khams gsum na sems can gyi don byed pa la mdzes pa'i yon tan phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas dar gyi cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ dar dpyangs thogs la/ mdzes shing yid 'ong dar gyi cod pan 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// shes bya kun la thogs pa med pa dang*// 'gro ba'i don la mthu dbang thob par shog /oṃ badzra paṭṭa a ba lamba na a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐/ zhes bskur/ de ltar dar gyi cod pan gyi dbang bskur bas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa dang*/

sems can gyi don byed pa la mthu thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de rnams kyis rin chen 'byung ldan cod pan gyi dbang bskur ba song nas/ da 'od dpag med phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan thogs la/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya lag tu gtad nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan rab rdzogs te// ye shes lnga ni myur du rtogs par shog /oṃ buddha mu dra a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ badzra hūm̐/ ratna trām̐/ padma hrīḥ karma āḥ zhes rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gtad/ de ltar rigs lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas/ rigs lnga ye shes lnga'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rnam par snang mdzad ming gi dbang bskur ba ni/ rdor dril thogs la/ kun rdzob mtshan nyid mtshon pa ming gi dbang*// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// ma 'ongs sangs rgyas 'jig rten zhing khams su// de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan gyi ming thob shog / rdor dril spyi bor bzhag la/ oṃ buddha nā ma a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ badzra hūm̐/ ratna trām̐/ padma hrīḥ karma āḥ kye dpal rdo rje sems dpa' zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes pa'am yang na so so'i gsang mtshan brjod/ de ltar ming gi dbang bskur bas ma 'ongs pa na rigs kyi gsang mtshan dang mthun par sangs rgyas pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin du mdzod/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las padma// a las zla ba'i steng du khyed rang rnams rdo rje sems dpa' sku mdog dkar po g.yas rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing g.yon dril bu dkur brten pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ sems dpa'i skyil krung gis bzhugs par gyur/ rdor sems kyi sku 'am dam rgya spyi bor bzhag nas/ oṃ badzra sa twa hūm̐/ zhes brjod/

khyed rang rnams lhar gsal ba la bstod cing bsngags par mos mdzod/ sangs rgyas kun pas sngar sangs rgyas// mi shes dri ma kun bcom pa// phyag na rdo rje rgyal dbang la// dga' ba'i bsam pas bstod par bya// zhes brjod/ de nas don yod grub pa dril bu'i dbang gi mtshon byed du rgya gram gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu gtad nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// phrin las rnam bzhis 'gro don mthar phyin nas// las kyi rigs kyi dngos grub thob par shog /oṃ karma a bhi ṣiñtsa āḥ zhes bskur/ de ltar rgya gram gyi dbang bskur bas/ phrin las bzhis bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed pa la mthu stobs thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas chos kyi 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba ni/ 'khor lo rkang pa'i bar du bzhag la/ yon tan rab rdzogs gser gyi 'khor lo 'dis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rnam par snang mdzad sku mchog rab thob ste// chos kyi 'khor lo myur du bskor bar shog /oṃ badzra tsakra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ bhrūm̐/ de ltar 'khor lo'i dbang bskur bas rnam par snang mdzad kyi sku thob ste chos kyi 'khor lo bskor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rigs thams cad kyi khyab bdag 'khor los sgyur ba'i dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi yu ba byas pa'i dril bu lnga gtad la/ rigs lnga'i bdag po yi ni rang bzhin gyis// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// rdo rje sems dpa' rigs rnams kun gyi bdag /rigs dang dkyil 'khor kun gyi bdag por shog oṃ buddha tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ oṃ oṃ/ oṃ badzra tsakra a dhi ba ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ oṃ ratna tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa trām̐ trām̐ trām̐/ oṃ padma tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hrī hrī hrīḥ

oṃ karma tsakra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa a a a/ de ltar rigs lnga'i bdag po'i dbang bskur bas rigs dang dkyil 'khor thams cad kyi bdag po'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas gzungs dbang bskur ba ni/ yum lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bor bzhag nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas// gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas su// 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par shog oṃ buddha dhā ra ni a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ badzra hūm̐/ ratna trām̐/ padma hrīḥ karma āḥ zhes pas bskur/ de ltar yum lnga'i phyag rgyas dbang bskur bas gsang rgyud mtha' dag shes shing rtogs nas gzhan la 'chad cing ston pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas gsang dbang bskur ba ni/ rigs lnga'i phyag rgya spyi bo sogs gnas lngar bzhag / rigs lnga'i phyag rgya gnas lngar bcings nas ni// skal ldan skyes bu khyod la dbang bskur bas/ ye shes lnga yi yon tan rab rdzogs te// byang sems gsang ba'i dbang dang ldan par shog /oṃ buddha gu hya a bhi ṣiñtsa oṃ/ de bzhin du/ badzra hūm̐/ ratna trām̐/ padma hrīḥ karma aḥ zhes pas gtad/ de ltar rigs lnga'i phyag mtshan gyi dbang bskur bas sangs rgyas rigs lnga'i thugs gsang ba byang chub kyi sems rtogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de ltar rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang thob nas dkyil 'khor dang lha'i de nyid dbang dang rab gnas sbyin sreg sogs slob dpon gyi bya ba mtha' dag mkhas par bslab nas/ 'gro ba gzhan gyi don bya snyam pas dkyil 'khor gyi de nyid rgyud las gsungs pa 'di gsan 'tshal/ sangs rgyas kun gyi byang chub sems// bla na med pa rtogs gyur pa// rgyal bas gsungs pa'i ye shes gang*// de ni dkyil 'khor snying por gsungs//

zhes brjod/ de nas hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje lag g.yas su gtad pas gsor zhing snying gar gtod de 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod// rdo rje gtad/ hūm̐/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems tshul bdag po'i bdag / ces dang*/ a yig las byung ba'i dril bu shes rab kyi rang bzhin/ lag pa g.yon du gtad pas dkrol zhing bsnyen pa'i tshul gyi dkur brten pa'i mos pa mdzod/ dril bu gtad/ aḥ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyi bdag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems dpa' mchog /srid pa mchog ni mdzad pa yin/ dharmā āḥ de nas rdor dril snying gar bsnol thabs su 'dzin pa'i mos pa mdzod// zhes bsnol bcug / de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis kyang*// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// phyag rgya'i dam tshig ces su grags// yid kyi gzugs ni brtan phyir ro// de ltar rdo rje thugs/ dril bu gsung*/ phyag rgya sku'i dam tshig gsum sbyin pas thabs dang shes rab zung du 'brel nas bdag dang gzhan gyi don byed pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas bka' bsgo ba ni/ de ring phan chad bu khyod kyi// phyag na rdo rje nga yin gyi// nga yis ji ltar bsgo ba bzhin// khyod kyis de ltar bya dgos so// oṃ pradzñāo pā ya sa ma yo ga a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ āḥ zhes brjod/ de nas mtha' brten gyi dbang ni/ rgyud las/ 'khor lo la sogs rin chen bdun thogs la// mi yi dbang phyug 'khor lo thob pa dang*// sdig pa gzhom phyir dbang ni bskur bar bya// zhes gsungs pas gnas skabs su 'khor los sgyur ba'i rgyal srid thob cing mthar thug khams gsum chos kyi rgyal po sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi go 'phang thob pa'i phyir rgyal srid sna bdun gyi dbang bskur ba ni/ 'khor lo thogs la/ lha rdzas las byas lte ba shin tu bzlums// rtsibs stong ldan zhing mu khyud rab mnyam bzang*// dang po'i sar gnas rnam par rgyal gyur gang*// 'khor lo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsakra ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/

phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyal ba'i chos kyi 'khor lo nam mkha'i mthar gtugs pa bskor nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / nor bu thogs la/ rin chen ngo bo lha rdzas bai ḍūrya// kun tu dpag tshad tsam du snang byed cing*// dri med nyin mo ji bzhin mtshan de bzhin// nor bu rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ ma ṇi ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ tshe dpag tu med pa'i 'od dang ldan zhing lha dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten thams cad rang gi gzi brjid kyis gnon pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / btsun mo thogs la/ gzugs mdzes lta na sdug cing tshul bzang ma// pags pa'i mdog legs 'jam zhing dri mchog ldan// yid 'ong 'dod dgu'i reg bya dang ldan pa// btsun mo rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ st+rī ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ sems can thams cad ting nge 'dzin zhi ba'i tshul gyis 'jig rten las 'das pa'i spyod yul yongs su dag nas rang gzhan gyi don bde bas bsgrub pa yid bzhin du 'byor ba'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / blon po thogs la/ gang yang rgyal ba mu tig mdangs ldan pas// gser sogs mang po thub la phul ba ltar// bzod ldan mtshungs pa'i khyim bdag don ldan te// blon po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ pu ru ṣa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ lha'i mig rnam par dag pa thob nas 'phags pa'i nor bdun dang ldan zhing rang gzhan gyi dgos pa mthar phyin nas shes bya thams cad la thogs pa med pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / glang po thogs la/ yan lag thams cad legs skyes sa la ni// rab gnas gangs chen ri 'dra glang po che// rgyal po la 'os mkha' la rab 'gro ba'i// glang po rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ hasti ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ stobs bcu dang ldan zhing bdud bzhi'i stobs tshar bcad nas sems can thams cad theg pa chen po la 'jug nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig

/ rta mchog thogs la/ tho rangs dus su phyogs rnams ma lus pa'i// sa rnams bskor nas slar yang ldog gyur pa// rma bya'i mgrin pa'i spu ltar yid 'ong ba'i// rta mchog rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ tu raṅga a shwa ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ so so yang dag pa rig pa bzhis 'gro ba rnams mi gnas pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su thogs pa med par skyel nus pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig / dmag dpon thogs la/ 'gro dang ldog dang kun nas 'ong 'gyur pa'i// ma lus bdud dpung 'jig par byed pa ste// dpal ldan 'byor pa'i dpung dang bcas pa yi// dmag dpon rin chen dam pas dbang bskur ro// oṃ khadga ratna a bhi ṣiñtsa māṃ/ thabs dang shes rab gnyis su med pa'i dgongs pa mthar phyin nas 'jig tshogs la lta ba'i ri bo mthon po nyi shu 'joms shing ye shes phun sum tshogs pa'i dbang dang ldan par gyur cig /de nas rgyud kyi dgongs pa bzhin du bka' yi dbang sbyin pa ni/ rdo rje sems dpa'i gnas 'dug nas// thams cad byas shing kun thos kyang*// 'grub 'gyur nyes pas mi gos na// snying rje ldan pas smos ci dgos// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta ā dzñā ta ya dā sya mi gṛ hṇa badzra su siddha ye/ oṃ badzra tiṣṭha hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas rjes su gdams pa ni 'di la gsan pas khyab par gda'/ tshe 'di'i bde ba ma lus dang*// 'jig rten phyi ma'i bde mchog dang*// sangs rgyas nyid kyang 'thob 'gyur na// lha mi'i bde ba smos ci dgos// sangs rgyas kun dang bla ma mnyam// rdo rje slob dpon brnyas na ni// rtag tu sdug bsngal thob 'gyur bas// slob dpon la ni brnyas mi bya// rdo rje spun dang sring mo dang*// rdo rje ma rnams nyid la ni// rnal 'byor can gyis brnyas mi bya// rtag tu 'khon dang gcugs mi bya// dkon mchog gsum la gnod byed la// bzod pa bsgom par mi bya ste// bla ma dmod brtson ma rungs dang*// dam tshig las ni 'da' ba dang*// de sogs byed pa tshar gcod na// 'grub 'gyur zhes ni kun rig gsung*// sems can kun la snying brtses chags// bsgrub na myur du 'grub par 'gyur//

zhes brjod/ de ltar bcom ldan 'das thams cad rig pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba legs par thob pa yin pas de dag gi skabs su bab pa'i dam tshig rnams tshul bzhin du bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs/ dbang bskur rdzogs par thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇḍal/ sa gzhi sogs/ lus longs spyod dge rtsa dang bcas pa 'bul snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos/ deng nas brtsams te sogs/ des kun rig rnam snang gi dkyil 'khor du dbang legs par thob pa yin pas de yi sgo nas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po sgrubs mdzod/ bsod nams 'di yis thams cad gzigs pa nyid// thob nas nyes pa'i dgra rnams pham byas te// skye rga na 'chi'i rba rlabs 'khrugs pa yi// srid pa'i mtsho las 'gro ba sgrol bar shog / ces brjod/ rjes chog gzhung ltar bya'o// ces pa 'di ni si tu padma'i ming can gyis bsgrigs pa sarba dā ka lyā ṇaṃ bha wantu/ dge'o//dge'o// dge'o//
